name: Warm ivory handmade-look tile 4 in

placement.origin: Centered X, rear mounting plane Y=0, bottom Z=0
placement.allowed_scaling: Rigid placement/rotation only. Repeat linked full modules at documented pitch; do not stretch.

rights: Original Homes project contributor geometry and procedural appearance. Attribution: Homes project contributors. No third-party downloads.

installation.mounting: Host provides stable continuous substrate, product-selected bonding/support, and substrate waterproofing behind Y=0. Adhesive thickness is not represented.
installation.joints: Leave perimeter and changes of plane as correctly specified flexible joints; do not fill movement joints with hard grout. Bottom datum is finish edge: host leaves a coordinated countertop junction below it.
installation.wet_limitations: Visual concept only. Neither geometry nor glaze establishes water absorption, stain resistance, waterproofing or cleaning compatibility. Verify selected material, grout, sealants and backing before wet use.
installation.heat_limitations: No flame, temperature or combustible-clearance rating. Range/cooktop instructions and the actual finish/bonding system govern all heat clearances; do not infer approval from ceramic or stone appearance.
required_host_checks: Outlets and fixture penetrations with correctly detailed edge cuts
Substrate capacity, adhesion, movement and waterproofing
Actual appliance heat clearances and finish suitability

variation.cuts: Project-specific boundary and outlet cuts may trim a copy of the mesh, retaining material scale and finish thickness; document cuts. Full modules stay linked. Exposed cuts need the host-selected finished edge or trim.

limitations: Editable architectural visualization asset; not a commercial product, tested assembly, construction detail or code approval. Available library option; no new home adoption is claimed.

module.joint_basis: 3.6 mm minimum between bounding square tile envelopes; gently irregular edges locally widen the joint.

material.type: Original procedural warm ivory ceramic glaze embedded with tile
material.texture_scale: Procedural microtexture at 620 per meter, 0.08 mm bump distance; actual front mesh relief up to 0.55 mm. Object-instance random creates restrained glaze-tone variation.

preview_content: Preview contains an 8-column x 6-row demonstration of linked tile modules with recessed warm-gray grout. Native collection contains only ONE tile; demo grout is not part of module. Hosts provide grout and backing.

installation_preview.kind: Illustrative studio installation specimen using actual linked native finish
installation_preview.counter_joint_fill: Separate physical 3 mm high concept sealant strip; adhesion, movement capacity and commercial sealant unresolved
installation_preview.termination: Illustrative 1 mm thick metal L-profile caps exposed side edges; 98 mm tiles retain their real 3.6 mm minimum field joints.

visual_inspection.notes: Actual linked finish, countertop junction and side termination visible; 3 mm sealant and counter-top bounds checked in Blender. Separate slab vertical joint visible where applicable. Studio specimen only; no real home or product approval.
